title: FSafeSubRow
html:
定义组：一阶语法与替换。有序参数：E、F、R、f、r、z1311、z1312、z1313。

free-for 的无捕获替换图；非全定义，绝不默许变量捕获。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ FSafeSubRow E F R f r z1311 z1312 z1313) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists x
  (exists s
    (exists t
      (exists u
        (and
          (exists z1316
            (and (exists z1317 (and (@ Pair t u z1317) (@ Pair s z1317 z1316))) (@ Pair x z1316 z1313)))
          (and
            (@ Nat x)
            (and
              (@ FTerm F f s)
              (and
                (@ FFm E F R f r t)
                (and
                  (@ FFm E F R f r u)
                  (or
                    (and (not (@ FFree E F R f r x t)) (= t u))
                    (or
                      (exists z1318
                        (exists z1319
                          (exists z1320
                            (exists z1321
                            (and
                            (@ FRel z1318 z1319 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FRel z1318 z1320 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Seq z1319 z1321)
                            (and
                            (@ Seq z1320 z1321)
                            (forall z1322
                            (implies
                            (in z1322 z1321)
                            (exists z1323
                            (exists z1324
                            (and (@ App z1319 z1322 z1323) (and (@ App z1320 z1322 z1324) (@ FTSub F f x s z1323 z1324)))))))))))))))
                      (or
                        (exists z1325
                          (exists z1326
                            (exists z1327
                            (exists z1328
                            (and
                            (@ FEq z1325 z1326 t)
                            (and (@ FEq z1327 z1328 u) (and (@ FTSub F f x s z1325 z1327) (@ FTSub F f x s z1326 z1328))))))))
                        (or
                          (exists z1325
                            (exists z1326
                            (and
                            (@ PNeg z1325 t)
                            (and
                            (@ PNeg z1326 u)
                            (exists z1334
                            (exists z1335
                            (and
                            (in z1334 z1312)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1311 z1334 z1335)
                            (exists z1336
                            (and (exists z1337 (and (@ Pair z1325 z1326 z1337) (@ Pair s z1337 z1336))) (@ Pair x z1336 z1335)))))))))))
                          (or
                            (exists z1325
                            (exists z1326
                            (exists z1327
                            (exists z1328
                            (and
                            (@ PImp z1325 z1326 t)
                            (and
                            (@ PImp z1327 z1328 u)
                            (and
                            (exists z1338
                            (exists z1339
                            (and
                            (in z1338 z1312)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1311 z1338 z1339)
                            (exists z1340
                            (and (exists z1341 (and (@ Pair z1325 z1327 z1341) (@ Pair s z1341 z1340))) (@ Pair x z1340 z1339)))))))
                            (exists z1342
                            (exists z1343
                            (and
                            (in z1342 z1312)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1311 z1342 z1343)
                            (exists z1344
                            (and (exists z1345 (and (@ Pair z1326 z1328 z1345) (@ Pair s z1345 z1344))) (@ Pair x z1344 z1343))))))))))))))
                            (exists z1329
                            (exists z1325
                            (exists z1326
                            (and
                            (@ FAll z1329 z1325 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FAll z1329 z1326 u)
                            (and
                            (not (= z1329 x))
                            (and
                            (not (@ FTFree F f z1329 s))
                            (exists z1330
                            (exists z1331
                            (and
                            (in z1330 z1312)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1311 z1330 z1331)
                            (exists z1332
                            (and (exists z1333 (and (@ Pair z1325 z1326 z1333) (@ Pair s z1333 z1332))) (@ Pair x z1332 z1331))))))))))))))))))))))))))))
